def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each row: extend the color-5 marks horizontally with color 3 between neighboring
    # marks, preserving 5 endpoints. Demos indicate spans only between markers in same row.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        marks=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
        for a,b in zip(marks,marks[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    return out

    return out
